about.blind_shot: a shot (a weapon's ammunition going down) while the enemy has not been in his view for 1.0 s or more; in view = inside a cone of 55 degrees round his view, under 4000 units, a clear line through the map from his eye to the enemy's chest or head
about.landing: rockets and plasma: his view traced from his eye to the first wall; grenades: the simulator's grenade flight (700 units a second, lofted, gravity, bounces keep 0.65) to where it lies when the 2.5 s fuse ends. A blind shot that lands under 150 units from his eye is 'at his own feet' (a rocket jump, a shot at the floor): it is counted, but the numbers of the landing (distance, met, hit) and 'blind and away' are of the others
about.met: the enemy in his view within 2 s of the shot and within 300 units of where it landed
about.hit: extra: his hit counter goes up in the 0.35 s round the moment the shot lands (a grenade: at any time until its fuse ends)
about.combination: the first rail or lightning shot within 1.5 s of a rocket (grenade) fired with the enemy in view (seen within the last 0.2 s), the rocket being his last shot before it
about.states: who leads is the player state's rank; the clock is the server time since the game's restart; frags and deaths a minute of his time in the state, dead time included
about.toward_enemy_speed: his velocity along the line to the enemy, averaged over the time the enemy is in view (the enemy's own movement is not in it)
about.travelling_speed: his mean horizontal speed while alive with no enemy in view
about.items: a pickup: his health (mega) or armor rising within 60 units of the item; back at its return: alive within 150 units of it at some moment from 2 s before to 2 s after (mega 35 s, armors 25 s after his pickup); counted only where the same stretch of the demo lasts that long
about.position: his time alive over cells of 192 x 192 x 96 units: the share in the 8 most used, the number of cells that hold 80% of it, the entropy in bits. 'per_player': each followed player of a demo with 3 minutes or more of his own, then the mean over them; 'pooled': the time of all of them on a map together. Over all maps: the mean of the maps
about.height: with the enemy in view: his origin 48 units or more above the enemy's, 48 or more below, or between. The lowest third: of the heights the pros visit on that map, from the 1st to the 99th percentile of their time (height_range, to be passed to report() for another player's games)
about.routes: a trip: from his pickup of one of mega, red armor, a yellow armor, a rocket launcher, the rail, the lightning gun to his next pickup of another of them (a weapon: its ammunition rising at its spot), alive throughout, 1 to 20 s. Its path is 16 points evenly along it; two trips are the same way when their paths lie within 200 units of each other on average (a trip joins the way whose first trip is nearest). A pair (from, to: the two directions apart) counts with 30 trips or more, a way with 5% of its pair's trips (3 at least)
about.standing: his speed under 50 units a second while alive; the longest stand in a minute: for every minute of the record with 30 s or more alive, the longest unbroken stand that reaches into it
about.aggression: a sighting: the enemy comes into his view after 1 s or more out of it. Read over the next 3 s (to his death, if he dies): his mean speed along the line to the enemy (plus = closing; where the enemy is not known, to where he last was); 'pushes': that mean over 150 units a second; whether he fires within 1 s; 'view broken': neither of them died and the enemy was out of his view for 0.5 s at a stretch (who broke it is not known); and over 10 s his frags less his deaths. The situation at the sighting: his health plus armor (under 60, 60 to 125, over 125); whether he owns rockets, lightning or rail with ammunition; how long ago he fragged this enemy (under 10 s: the enemy has just spawned; what he did before a cut of the demo is not known and counts as 'not yet'); the weapon in the enemy's hand (rockets, lightning, rail = big); who leads
about.walking: his feet on the ground and his horizontal speed steady (changing by under 3 units a second from frame to frame, the frame before and after); the walking speed is the fullest 10-unit bin of that time from 100 to 260 units a second if it stands clear of the bins 30 units either side, and walking is the steady time in that bin and the one either side of it, not crouched. Crouched and moving: his eye low, on the ground, 50 units a second or more. Standing: under 50. 'Quiet' is the three together
about.spam_when: the blind shots that land 150 units or more from himself. The landing place within 300 units of the nearest of mega, armors, rocket launcher, rail, lightning; a mega or armor's return 'as far as he knows': his own last pickup of it in this stretch plus 35 s (mega) or 25 s (armor), if that lies ahead; 'unknown' if he did not take it or it should be back. Hurt: his health plus armor went down by 20 (50) or more in the 5 s before, single losses of under 3 not counted
about.hit_combinations: from his own hit counter: a step of it on a frame he fires lightning, rail, machine gun or shotgun on (or the frame before) is that weapon's hit; any other step is the hit of the rocket, grenade or plasma ball of his that is due about then (from 0.05 s after the shot to 0.2 s after it would reach the wall his view pointed at; a grenade until its fuse ends). A pair: a rocket (grenade) that hit, then the first lightning or rail hit within 1.5 s. A frag 'after a pair': within 2 s of the pair's second hit
not_measured: whether a blind shot did damage, exactly: a demo has no damage events. The extra 'hit' is his own hit counter going up as the shot lands
where the enemy is while the server does not send him (out of sight and away): 'met' misses an enemy who was there unseen, and a blind shot at an enemy heard is not told from one at nothing
the enemy's health, armor and weapons: play by 'who is stronger' can only be read from P's own stack
the enemy's pickups and an item's true state while it is out of his sight: the return time counts from P's own pickup only; an item the enemy took in between returns later than counted
the enemy's score as a number (the lead is exact, from the rank)
the game clock of a demo that begins in a running game, and of a game with a timeout
sounds: what he heard is not in a demo
a grenade that went off on a player before its fuse ended
